power_scope: Arithmetic mean of original whole-card samples recorded while 0<samples<training_budget; includes the sampled training-active window, excludes final GPU readout under the original sampler condition
power_weighting: Native point-sample mean; not a time-integrated energy or attributed device-only measurement
TotalCPU_reason: Parent TotalCPU is zero/unreported at this site; do not report it as measured zero training CPU
Slurm_accounting_scope: Original parent allocation only; no queue, batch/extern or observation step is added twice
